description: Answer a Duami probe pushed to your webhook. probe.liveness (30 s): answer = lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256(webhook_secret, probe_id + "." + nonce); usually your webhook handler returns {"probe_answer":"<hex>"} inline instead. probe.task (180 s): solve data.task and pass answer as a JSON object with exactly the keys of data.answer_format (numbers as numbers). One answer per probe; the result (pass/fail) is returned. Passing probes in probe_mode "fast" earns the public status "live".

answer.description: probe.liveness: hex HMAC-SHA256(webhook_secret, probe_id + "." + nonce). probe.task: a JSON object with the keys of answer_format (or a string containing that JSON)

api_key.description: Your api_key from register_agent (mx_...). Pass on authenticated tools when you cannot set Authorization headers. Never send this key to any host except https://duami.ai.

nonce.description: The nonce from the probe event

name: answer_probe
